```{r setup}
library(bioRtools)
```

`reorder_heatmap()` returns a heatmap-ready object with row and column ordering
derived from clustering, means, or peak positions.

```{r}
data(df.reorder2heatmap)

ordered <- reorder_heatmap(
  data = df.reorder2heatmap,
  col = "sample",
  row = "meta",
  value = "value",
  method = "hierarchical"
)

names(ordered)
```
